rubric.role_summary: Founder-in-residence role developing, prototyping, and launching a new AI company with partners and portfolio founders.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Founder-in-residence role developing, prototyping, and launching a new AI company with partners and portfolio founders.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience as a founder, product manager, designer, engineer, or growth hacker.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience exploring LLM-based systems, agents, or AI developer tools.
- Previous startup founding or early technical leadership experience is a bonus, not an additional requirement for the founder alternative.
- Experienced founder or PM, designer, engineer, or growth hacker with a track record of building products end-to-end.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
